scripts.build: npm run build:shared && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/*.html src/renderer/*.css src/renderer/*.js dist/renderer/
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run brand && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run brand && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --dev
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "dist-test/test/*.test.js"
